idea-plugin.name: Dart Data Toolkit
idea-plugin.description:
Automatically generates essential methods for Dart classes directly from the editor.

Features:
  • copyWith() — creates modified copies of the class
  • toJson() — serializes the class to a JSON map
  • fromJson() — deserializes a class from a JSON map
  • toString() — formatted multiline string representation
  • Dart Class from JSON — generates a complete Dart class from a pasted JSON object
  • Barrel File — exports selected Dart files from a folder into a single index file
Shortcuts:
  • Alt+Insert — individual method actions inside the Generate menu
  • Ctrl+Alt+D — generate multiple methods at once
  • Ctrl+Alt+J — generate Dart class from JSON
  • Ctrl+Alt+B — generate barrel file
Supports nullable types (String?, int?, etc.) and generic types (List<T>, Map<K, V>).
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0
  • Initial release
  • copyWith(), toJson(), fromJson(), toString() generators
  • Dart class generation from JSON with auto-formatting
  • Barrel file generator with checkbox UI and recursive mode
  • Individual method actions in the Generate menu (Alt+Insert)
  • Nullable and generic type support
